# SuperDo is one of my favorite agents I built in Dreamer. Here's the backstory. · 2026-02-17T00:00:00+00:00

SuperDo is one of my favorite agents I built in Dreamer. Here's the backstory.

I've been obsessed with to-do apps my entire professional life. Back when I was a PM on the Android team in the early 2010s, I helped start Google Keep as a 20% project. For years I remained proud of building a simple, fast and really useful to-do app.

Google Keep is still timelessly awesome, but it's clear to-do's could use some reinvention.

Enter Dreamer.

Over the holiday break, my wife Laura Griffiths and I set off to try and reinvent to-dos. Our goal was to create an agentic app that just... took care of things. So we built SuperDo in Dreamer.

With SuperDo, all you have to do is enter your to-do as you normally would. SuperDo then creates a sub-agent (via a Sidekick Task) that researches your entire personal context (emails, calendar, msgs, docs) to figure out steps to get that thing done. It'll also automatically update your to-dos -- including checking it off your list for example when it sees an email update. And Laura's favorite feature -- SuperDo proactively turns emails or msgs into to-dos for you.

What's interesting here is that in our previous tech era there would be an _entire_ VC-backed company building this, and I don't think they would have come as far as we did over two weekends building SuperDo.
